Una acción clara, en el momento adecuado: A clear action at the right moment.
Utiliza Button para acciones y asChild c: Use Button for actions and asChild with a link for navigation. In forms, set type="button" when the action should not submit data.
Agrupa acciones relacionadas en una mism: Group related actions in a single row.
Combina botones con variantes coherentes: Combine buttons with consistent variants. Use distinct labels so each action is recognizable.
Una pequeña etiqueta para estados, categ: A small label for statuses, categories and updates.
Comunica el estado también con texto. Un: Convey status with text as well as color. Badge describes information; use Button to perform an action.
Jerarquía tipográfica con el mismo lengu: Typography with a shared visual language.
Elige el nivel del título por su posició: Choose heading levels based on document structure. Keep one main h1 and use paragraphs for body content.
Un contenedor para dar contexto y estruc: A container that gives content context and structure.
Compón la tarjeta con Header, Title, Des: Compose the card with Header, Title, Description, Content and Footer. The container does not dictate how its actions behave.
Representa una persona con imagen o inic: Represent a person with an image or initials.
Proporciona texto alternativo a AvatarIm: Provide alternative text for AvatarImage and an AvatarFallback while an image loads or is unavailable.
Usa orientation para cambiar el eje. Con: Use orientation to change the axis. decorative indicates that the separator is purely visual.
Reserva proporciones estables para imáge: Keep stable proportions for images and visual content.
Define ratio como ancho dividido por alt: Set ratio to width divided by height. Give the container a width so its height can be calculated.
Describe un atajo existente en la aplica: Describe an existing shortcut in your application. Kbd only displays the keys; register the keyboard event in your own code.
Código con formato, numeración y copia i: Formatted code with line numbers and copying.
Indica language para el resaltado y file: Set language for highlighting and filename to give the snippet context. Content must be a string.
Entrada de texto con tamaños, validación: Text input with sizes, validation and masks.
Asocia una etiqueta mediante htmlFor e i: Associate a label using htmlFor and id. Use invalid for the visual error state and aria-describedby to explain how to fix it.
Texto libre con contador y altura adapta: Free-form text with a counter and adaptive height.
Usa minRows y maxRows junto con autoResi: Combine minRows and maxRows with autoResize to fit the content. maxLength sets the field limit.
Conecta htmlFor con el id del control. E: Connect htmlFor to the control's id. A placeholder complements the label but does not replace it.
Etiqueta, ayuda, control y error en una: Label, hint, control and error in one unit.
Group fields with FieldGroup or FieldSet. Use FieldDescription for instructions and FieldError for validation messages.
Add context and actions to an input.
Combina Input con adornos y botones. Man: Combine Input with adornments and buttons. Keep an accessible label for the field and for icon-only buttons.
Un código de verificación, dividido en p: A verification code split into slots.
Define maxLength y una posición index pa: Set maxLength and an index for each slot. Your server must validate the code; the component only collects input.
Una elección independiente o parte de un: An independent choice or part of a multiple selection.
Usa checked y onCheckedChange para contr: Use checked and onCheckedChange to control it from React. The value can also be indeterminate for a partial selection.
Activa o desactiva una preferencia inmed: Turn a preference on or off immediately.
Reserva Switch para configuraciones bina: Reserve Switch for binary settings. In controlled mode connect checked and onCheckedChange without waiting for form submission.
Cada RadioGroupItem necesita un value di: Each RadioGroupItem needs a unique value and label. The group shares state through value and onValueChange.
Selección con búsqueda, grupos, carga as: Selection with search, groups, asynchronous loading and option creation.
La API usa options con objetos label/val: The API uses options with label/value objects; onChange receives the selected object. loadOptions enables asynchronous loading; isCreatable allows new options and can be combined with loadOptions. Use defaultOptions for initial loading and cacheOptions to reuse searches. Do not compose SelectItem as a Radix Select: compatibility exports are HTML elements.
Ajusta un valor o un intervalo con preci: Precisely adjust a value or interval.
value y defaultValue son arrays. Usa min: value and defaultValue are arrays. Use min, max and step to define the allowed range; add an accessible label.
Selección de fechas con una vista de cal: Date selection in a calendar view.
Se basa en DayPicker. Combina mode=\"sin: Based on DayPicker. Combine mode="single" with selected and onSelect; use mode="range" for date ranges.
Un selector de fecha compacto con calend: A compact date picker with a dropdown calendar.
Usa value y onValueChange para integrarl: Use value and onValueChange to integrate it into a form. mode supports date, range, month or year; withTime adds time selection.
A button with a pressed state.
Usa pressed y onPressedChange para herra: Use pressed and onPressedChange for formatting tools or preferences. Text or aria-label must explain the action.
Una barra de opciones de selección simpl: A toolbar for single or multiple selection.
Define type=\"single\" o type=\"multiple: Set type="single" or type="multiple". Each ToggleGroupItem needs a stable value.
Define un id único por pregunta y proces: Define a unique id per question and handle onComplete. Supports single, multiple and freeform; set optional for non-required questions.
Usa type=\"single\" para abrir un elemen: Use type="single" to open one item or multiple for several. Each AccordionItem requires a unique value.
Vistas relacionadas dentro del mismo con: Related views within the same context.
Relaciona cada TabsTrigger y TabsContent: Match each TabsTrigger and TabsContent using the same value. Use tabs to switch content, not to replace links to other pages.
Muestra el camino hasta la página actual: Show the path to the current page.
Usa enlaces en los niveles anteriores y: Use links for previous levels and BreadcrumbPage for the current location. Keep separators decorative.
Usa NavigationMenuLink para destinos y T: Use NavigationMenuLink for destinations and Trigger with Content for groups. Keep clear names and keyboard navigation.
Mantén el estado de página en tu aplicac: Keep page state in your application and connect events. Mark the current link with isActive.
Una lista de acciones que se filtra al e: An action list that filters as you type.
Define value en cada acción y maneja onS: Set value on each action and handle onSelect. CommandDialog displays the search interface in a dialog.
Una conversación enfocada sobre la inter: A focused conversation over your interface.
Incluye siempre Title y Description. El: Always include Title and Description. The trigger opens the panel, Escape closes it and focus returns to the original control. You can manage open and onOpenChange.
Un panel lateral para tareas que necesit: A side panel for tasks that need context.
Un panel deslizante para contenido compl: A sliding panel for supporting content.
Información o controles al lado de su ac: Information or controls beside their trigger.
Usa Popover para contenido interactivo b: Use Popover for short interactive content. Content supports alignment and distance from the trigger.
A brief explanation for a control.
Monta TooltipProvider alrededor de los t: Wrap tooltips in TooltipProvider. Avoid interactive controls inside tooltips; use Popover instead.
Una vista previa contextual al pasar el: A contextual preview on hover or focus.
El contenido es complementario: la infor: The content is supplementary: essential information must also be available at the linked destination.
Menú de acciones desplegable o barra de: A dropdown action menu or menu bar.
Conecta onSelect en los elementos de acc: Connect onSelect on action items. Combine separators, groups, checkbox options and submenus.
Tablas semánticas con una presentación c: Semantic tables with a consistent presentation.
Usa TableHead para encabezados y TableCa: Use TableHead for headings and TableCaption to describe the dataset. Use DataTable for sorting, filtering and pagination.
Datos con búsqueda, ordenación, selecció: Data with search, sorting, selection and pagination.
Define columns con accessorKey y header,: Define columns using accessorKey and header and pass data as an array. Columns use LegacyColumnDef from the TanStack version included in Kivora.
Gráficos de Recharts con colores y toolt: Recharts charts with Kivora colors and tooltips.
ChartContainer proporciona el contexto v: ChartContainer provides visual context; configure series using label and color. Give the chart an explicit height.
BarChart, Bar y XAxis pertenecen a recha: BarChart, Bar and XAxis come from recharts. Install recharts as a direct dependency if you import them in your application.
Muestra cuánto se ha completado de una t: Show how much of a task is complete.
Usa value de 0 a max. El progreso debe r: Use a value between 0 and max. Progress must represent real data; do not use it as a simulated timer.
Mensajes de información, éxito, adverten: Information, success, warning or error messages.
Combine AlertTitle with AlertDescription. Choose a variant based on meaning and add instructions if the user needs to act.
Da contexto cuando todavía no hay conten: Provide context when there is no content yet.
Explica por qué está vacío y ofrece una: Explain why it is empty and offer a useful action. Use different messages for no data and no search results.
Imita la estructura aproximada del resul: Approximate the final structure to reduce layout shifts. Respect the user's motion preferences.
Usa label para describir qué se está car: Use label to describe what is loading. Change size and variant to fit the available space.
Notificaciones breves que acompañan una: Brief notifications that accompany an action.
Monta un solo Toaster en tu aplicación y: Mount one Toaster in your application and call toast from event handlers. Do not use toasts as the only place for errors that require correction.
Una fila de contenido con texto, iconos: A content row with text, icons and actions.
Compón ItemMedia, ItemContent y ItemActi: Compose ItemMedia, ItemContent and ItemActions for lists. ItemGroup groups related items.
Un archivo con descripción, acciones y p: A file with description, actions and progress.
El componente representa el archivo; no: The component represents a file; it does not upload it. Use FileUpload to transfer data.
Una burbuja visual para mensajes y fragm: A visual bubble for messages and short snippets.
Utiliza variant para distinguir mensajes: Use variant to distinguish messages and keep conversation state in your application.
Estructura para conversaciones con autor: Conversation structure with author, body and status.
Usa align para distinguir emisor y recep: Use align to distinguish sender and recipient. MessageScroller can follow new messages when follow is enabled.
Combina MarkerIcon y MarkerContent. Util: Combine MarkerIcon and MarkerContent. Use variants to adapt borders or spacing to the context.
Contenido que se recorre diapositiva a d: Content you can browse slide by slide.
Las opciones son de react-slick. Usa set: Options come from react-slick. Use settings or opts and provide controls so navigation does not depend on gestures or autoplay.
Una región de desplazamiento con estilo: A scrolling region with consistent styling.
Establece una altura para el área y aseg: Set a height and make the area's purpose clear. Content remains keyboard accessible. virtualized enables large lists: items, renderItem and estimateSize on web; FlatList data and renderItem on native.
Define direction en el grupo y límites m: Set direction on the group and minSize/maxSize on panels. ResizableHandle supports keyboard interaction.
Códigos de barras y QR en un único compo: Barcodes and QR codes in one component.
format define la codificación. EAN y UPC: format defines the encoding. EAN and UPC require valid values and check digits. onError and fallback handle invalid input.
Vídeo y audio con controles, pistas y re: Video and audio with controls, tracks and adaptive playback.
Pasa source con id y src. Usa una URL de: Pass source with id and src. Use a supported media URL with CORS when necessary. Configure controls and advanced features through props.
La demo usa un vídeo local del sitio. DR: The demo uses a local site video. DRM requires a license server; HLS/DASH sources, ads and downloads depend on service and browser configuration.
Selección de archivos y transferencias c: File selection and transfers with progress.
Crea un UploadController estable y liber: Create a stable UploadController and release its resources on unmount. Simple mode supports custom transport; advanced uses a Tus endpoint and confirms uploads from the dashboard.
Abrir el modal, seleccionar, editar y el: Opening the modal and selecting, editing or removing files do not require a server. Advanced mode does not support createTask: it uses Tus transport and starts transfers only when Upload is pressed. /api/uploads is an example path, not a configured server. Remote sources require Companion and its server credentials.
Contexto de tema y modo de color para tu: Theme and color mode context for your application.
Móntalo en un Client Component del layou: Mount it in a layout Client Component. colorMode updates the document's dark class. themeOverrides changes the context object; customize CSS colors with variables.
El provider ya está montado en esta docu: The provider is already mounted in this documentation. Avoid nesting providers with different color modes: both update the document's dark class.
Dirección de lectura compartida para int: Shared reading direction for LTR and RTL interfaces.
Usa dir=\"rtl\" para idiomas de derecha: Use dir="rtl" for right-to-left languages. Your application must translate the content.
Mantén una sesión de audio entre cambios: Keep an audio session across page changes.
Móntalo en un layout persistente. useAud: Mount it in a persistent layout. useAudioPlayer returns play and close to control the session from descendants.
Para iniciar audio, llama a play({ id: \: To start audio, call play({ id: "track", src: "/audio.mp3", type: "audio", title: "My track" }) with an existing file. The provider must sit above pages that share playback.

Kivora es una biblioteca TypeScript de c: Kivora is a TypeScript component library for Next.js and React. It brings forms, navigation, tables, panels and multimedia together under one visual language. Start with a button and compose an entire application using the same conventions.
El paquete web es @kivora/nextjs. Los ej: The web package is @kivora/nextjs. The examples and properties in this documentation correspond to version 0.2.0 installed from npm.
De una idea a una interfaz: From an idea to an interface
Productos SaaS: cuentas, equipos, permis: SaaS products: accounts, teams, visual permissions and validated forms.
Herramientas internas: tablas de datos,: Internal tools: data tables, filters, selection and detail panels.
Sitios y experiencias: navegación, tarje: Sites and experiences: navigation, cards, carousels and brand themes.
Experiencias multimedia: reproducción de: Multimedia experiences: video and audio playback, file selection and QR codes.
Los componentes resuelven la interfaz. L: Components provide the interface. Authentication, persistence, payments and upload services belong to your application.
Open any component to try it. Change a property with the controls or edit the JSX directly: the preview updates as you type and displays syntax errors. Reset restores the original example.
El botón Copiar prepara un componente co: The Copy button prepares a component with its imports. The API reference includes published properties and subcomponents; types are generated from npm TypeScript declarations.
Esta página explica la instalación web c: This page explains web installation with Next.js. Use the assistant or follow the manual steps. React without Next.js and React Native have separate guides.
Para la instalación manual necesitas un: Manual installation requires a Next.js project with React and React DOM 18 or later. Kivora includes compiled CSS, so this approach does not require Tailwind or PostCSS. The @kivora/init 0.1.1 assistant configures Tailwind 4.1–4.x and requires Node.js 20.19+ and Next.js 13+.
Los pasos siguientes asumen que app/ est: The following steps assume app/ is at the root. Preserve your existing plugins, styles and providers when integrating the configuration.
También puedes usar npx @kivora/init par: You can also use npx @kivora/init for assisted installation. Add --dry-run to review proposed changes before applying them. @kivora/theme is a transitive dependency; declare it as a direct dependency too if you import it in your code.
La hoja incluye las clases de los compon: The stylesheet includes component classes, tokens, base styles and bundled assets. Import it once. It needs no @source or PostCSS configuration. Use CSS or style for custom styles; new Tailwind classes need your own compiler.
Opcional: si tu aplicación ya usa Tailwi: Optional: if your application already uses Tailwind
Use this entry instead of styles.css if you already have Tailwind 4.1+ and its compiler configured. It generates your own utilities and detects Kivora classes automatically. Do not import both entries.
El layout puede seguir siendo un Server: The layout can remain a Server Component. Use "use client" in components that manage state, events or browser APIs. You can now import Button and start composing.
Conserva tu configuración existente de N: Keep your existing Next.js configuration. Import @kivora/nextjs/styles.css and mount KivoraProvider in pages/_app.tsx. You do not need Tailwind, PostCSS or @source.
Configura tu proyecto con un comando: Configure your project with one command
@kivora/init es el asistente oficial de: @kivora/init is the official setup assistant. Run the command inside an existing application's directory, alongside its package.json. It detects Next.js or React Native and proposes the required files and dependencies. It does not create an application or install or migrate the framework.
Usa npx @kivora/init. npm install @kivor: Use npx @kivora/init. npm install @kivora/init only adds the package to your dependencies; it does not run setup. You do not need to keep the assistant as an application dependency.
Esta guía corresponde a @kivora/init 0.1: This guide covers @kivora/init 0.1.1. It requires Node.js 20.19 or later in addition to framework requirements. It detects npm, pnpm, Yarn or Bun from packageManager and lockfiles, including those in a parent workspace.
Next.js: versión 13+, React y React DOM: Next.js: version 13+, React and React DOM 18+, Tailwind >=4.1 <5. The assistant adds Tailwind and PostCSS if missing; it does not migrate Tailwind 3. Manual web installation can use compiled CSS without Tailwind.
React Native: Community CLI >=0.85.3 <0.86, React >=19.2 <20, NativeWind >=4.2.6 <5, Reanimated >=4.3.0 <4.4, Worklets >=0.8.3 <0.9 and Tailwind >=3.4.17 <4. Babel preset and Metro config must be from the 0.85 series.
No ofrece una opción React/Vite ni migra: There is no React/Vite option and it does not migrate Expo projects. If both frameworks or neither are detected, it asks you to choose; that choice does not turn a React web project into Next.js.
Revisa el plan antes de aplicarlo: Review the plan before applying it
--dry-run muestra el contenido actual y: --dry-run shows current and proposed content without writing files or installing packages. In a normal run, the assistant validates the plan and asks for confirmation before writing. It preserves declared versions and installs only missing dependencies.
--framework nextjs|native: plataforma ya: --framework nextjs|native: framework already installed in the project.
--skip-install: escribe la configuración: --skip-install: write configuration and show pending installation commands.
--yes: acepta el plan sin confirmación;: --yes: accept the plan without confirmation; use deliberately in automation.
--package-manager npm|pnpm|yarn|bun: eli: --package-manager npm|pnpm|yarn|bun: choose a manager if none is defined. Does not replace an existing manager.
Next.js: añade @kivora/nextjs, Tailwind: Next.js: adds @kivora/nextjs, Tailwind and PostCSS if missing; configures transpilePackages and the PostCSS plugin; generates provider and CSS files and connects them to App Router or Pages Router.
React Native: añade @kivora/native y dep: React Native: adds @kivora/native and native dependencies, configures Babel, Metro and Tailwind, and integrates gesture, safe area, keyboard and Kivora providers with their color variables.
En Android añade POST_NOTIFICATIONS cuan: On Android it adds POST_NOTIFICATIONS when a manifest exists. It does not run native builds or change Gradle, Podfile or image assets.
Configuraciones dinámicas con funciones,: Dynamic configurations with functions, spreads or unrecognized options may require manual integration. Conflicting package managers or incompatible version ranges stop the plan before writing. Do not force another version without reviewing compatibility.
El asistente guarda copias en .kivora/ba: The assistant stores copies in .kivora/backups/<id>/ and a manifest.json mapping each file to its backup. Keep backups until you review the integration and do not publish them. If the package manager fails, it restores files and lockfiles, but node_modules changes and script side effects are not a reversible transaction.
Al terminar, revisa los estilos y ejecut: After setup, review styles and run your application's checks. On native, install pods using your project workflow, restart Metro and rebuild. The installer's README states that its iOS integration has not been validated.
Para una aplicación React que renderiza: For a React application rendered in the browser, use @kivora/nextjs. Its peer dependencies require React and React DOM 18+. Use a bundler that can import CSS, such as the one in your existing React project.
@kivora/init 0.1.1 no tiene una opción R: @kivora/init 0.1.1 has no React/Vite option: do not select nextjs if your project does not use that framework. This integration is manual. You do not need @kivora/native for browser rendering.
Importa estilos y monta el provider: Import styles and mount the provider
Importa el CSS una sola vez en la entrad: Import CSS once at your application's entry point and wrap App in KivoraProvider. Preserve existing providers. The example assumes index.html contains an element with id="root".
styles.css incluye las utilidades y toke: styles.css includes library utilities and tokens: you do not need Tailwind for these components. Add your styles after Kivora CSS. A client-only application does not need the use client directive.
Si tu bundler ya compila Tailwind 4.1+,: If your bundler already compiles Tailwind 4.1+, use @kivora/nextjs/tailwind.css instead of styles.css. Keep your bundler's compiler configuration. Do not import both stylesheets or copy next.config.ts into an application that does not use Next.js.
Una instalación propia para React Native: A separate installation for React Native
En tu aplicación móvil utiliza @kivora/n: Use @kivora/native in your mobile application. It shares Kivora's visual language and themes but does not render HTML: its events, providers and dependencies are native. Do not install @kivora/nextjs or import its CSS in the mobile application.
La vía asistida de @kivora/init 0.1.1 es: Assisted setup with @kivora/init 0.1.1 targets React Native Community CLI without Expo. You need an existing native application and Node.js 20.19+.
Estos son los límites del asistente, más: These are the assistant's limits, narrower than the native package's peer ranges. A range accepted by npm does not prove all combinations are tested. Do not mix these instructions with NativeWind 5, Reanimated 3 or Expo.
Instala y configura con el asistente: Install and configure with the assistant
El asistente prepara Babel, Metro, Tailw: The assistant prepares Babel, Metro, Tailwind, CSS and NativeWind types; connects App or src/App to GestureHandlerRootView, SafeAreaProvider, KeyboardProvider and KivoraProvider; and applies the required color variables. Review generated files before continuing.
Este ejemplo es una pantalla dentro de l: This example is a screen inside the root already configured by the assistant. Keep its providers and NativeWind variables. In React Native, text goes inside Text and the press event is onPress.
iOS: instala pods con el flujo de tu pro: iOS: install pods using your project workflow and rebuild the application.
Reinicia Metro limpiando la caché despué: Restart Metro with a cleared cache after changing Babel, Metro or Tailwind. Use your project scripts to rebuild Android or iOS.
Las notificaciones necesitan un icono An: Notifications need an existing Android icon. The assistant adds the permission when it finds the manifest but does not create that asset.
Los componentes multimedia pueden necesi: Multimedia components may require additional dependencies and configuration; consult the package notes for each feature.
El README de @kivora/init 0.1.1 indica q: The @kivora/init 0.1.1 README states that the assistant's iOS integration is not validated. The native package describes checks in its reference environment on Android and an iOS simulator, plus a css-interop fix it does not distribute automatically. These do not guarantee every external installation.
La instalación manual requiere integrar: Manual installation requires integrating native dependencies, Babel, Metro, Tailwind, providers and variables. npm install @kivora/native alone does not finish setup. Follow the README for your chosen version and review existing dependencies before changing versions.
KivoraProvider acepta colorMode=\"light\: KivoraProvider accepts colorMode="light", "dark" or "system". The resolved mode updates the document's dark class. Mount a top-level provider to prevent competing modes.
Usa bg-background, text-foreground, bg-p: Use bg-background, text-foreground, bg-primary and border-border. Names describe each color's role, so the interface can switch themes without changing every component.
La home y esta documentación comparten l: The home page and documentation share the same variables: violet in light mode, lavender in dark mode, pink and sage green. The header controls let you try all four palettes.
Personaliza pares de tokens: primary con: Customize token pairs: primary with primary-foreground, card with card-foreground, and so on. Check readability in hover, focus and disabled states.
Los paneles que usan portales pueden ren: Panels using portals may render under body. If you scope variables to a section, also configure the portal container or apply the palette at document level.
Variables CSS y objeto de tema: CSS variables and the theme object
themeOverrides modifica el objeto que de: themeOverrides changes the object returned by useKivoraTheme but does not generate CSS variables automatically. If you consume both the theme object and CSS classes, keep the two representations aligned.
Kivora no te obliga a adoptar la tipogra: Kivora does not require the typography used in these examples. This site keeps Geist and Geist Mono. Define font-family in your application and use typography components to organize the hierarchy.
Los componentes compuestos exponen pieza: Compound components expose small pieces: CardHeader, CardContent and CardFooter; DialogTrigger and DialogContent; TabsList and TabsContent. Preserve the required structure and adapt the content to your product.
defaultValue, defaultChecked y defaultOp: defaultValue, defaultChecked and defaultOpen set the initial state of an uncontrolled component. Use value/checked/open with the corresponding callback when state lives in React. Do not mix both strategies in the same control.
Cuando un componente admite asChild, apl: When a component supports asChild, it applies its behavior to a single compatible child instead of creating another element. Use it to turn a Button into a link or use a Button as a dialog trigger.
The child must accept props and ref. Do not nest buttons inside buttons or links inside links.
Conecta los servicios cuando los necesit: Connect services when you need them
Los formularios recogen información; tu: Forms collect information; your application validates and saves it. DataTable receives rows; your service fetches them. FileUpload needs a Tus endpoint or custom transport. Player needs media and, when applicable, license services.
Separa el estado visual del estado remot: Separate visual state from remote state: show when an operation is pending, confirm its result and allow recovery from errors.
Todos los controles deben tener un nombr: Every control needs an accessible name. Associate Label and Input using htmlFor/id and add aria-label to icon-only buttons. Do not rely on placeholders to name fields.
Tab y Shift+Tab deben recorrer controles: Tab and Shift+Tab should traverse controls in a logical order.
El foco visible debe conservar suficient: Visible focus must retain sufficient contrast.
Escape debe cerrar los paneles y devolve: Escape should close panels and return focus to their trigger.
Las pestañas, menús y grupos de opciones: Tabs, menus and option groups should respond to the appropriate arrow keys.
Las primitivas proporcionan comportamien: Primitives provide keyboard behavior, but the final composition still needs testing. Custom styles must not hide focus or block controls.
Respeta la jerarquía de encabezados, uti: Respect heading hierarchy, use links for navigation and buttons for actions. Include DialogTitle and DialogDescription in panels and captions when a table needs context.
El color no debe ser la única señal de e: Color must not be the only signal for error, success or selection. Add text and relationships such as aria-describedby; announce relevant changes in status regions.
Prueba zoom al 200 %, tamaños de móvil y: Test 200% zoom, mobile sizes and reduced-motion preferences. An attractive example does not replace reviewing the entire flow with a keyboard and screen reader.
Las variantes de tema deben comprobarse: Test theme variants separately: customizing tokens changes contrast and can affect text, borders and interactive states.
@kivora/nextjs proporciona los component: @kivora/nextjs provides web components. @kivora/native targets React Native. Both share types and themes from @kivora/theme without requiring you to install both renderers.

Los atributos DOM, los motores de tablas: DOM attributes, table engines and react-slick options are not interchangeable with React Native. Resizable belongs to the web package; Menu is available on both platforms; the native library adds BottomSheet.
Estas páginas documentan la API de @kivo: These pages document the @kivora/nextjs 0.2.0 API. Consult the README and types of your installed native version when building native components.
